revision_reason: Preserved run1 stopped on native floating-point roundoff above 1; domain validation now admits at most 1e-12 roundoff without changing scientific comparisons or statistical margins
scope: Reduced Werner primitives, native circuits, optical survival and classical event delays; not full network or hardware qualification
statistical_method: Bonferroni simultaneous Clopper-Pearson intervals, entirely contained in prospective equivalence margins; 10 proportions per backend, two planned backends

mappings.state: Independent Werner inputs, Bell order Phi+, Phi-, Psi+, Psi-; fidelity relative to corrected Phi+
mappings.memory_sequence: Pair lifetime T -> both local isotropic Pauli memory coherence times 8*T/3, before measuring
mappings.memory_netsquid: Pair visibility decay implemented by one equivalent local depolarizing channel; not two raw hardware coherence times
mappings.fiber: km to m, dB/km to dB/m, s to ps (SeQUeNCe) or ns (NetSquid); speed configured explicitly
mappings.insertion_sequence: Total scalar loss distributed along nonzero channel length, survival equivalence only; insertion location not validated
mappings.operations: Ideal local gates and measurements, operation_error=0; full local BSM conditioned on outcome, not optical BSM heralding efficiency
mappings.purification: Bilateral CNOT and target parity accept/reject; conditional Phi+ fidelity, twirling does not change target fidelity
mappings.classical: OrionQ runtime fiber propagation at c/1.468, route_factor=1, processing latency/jitter=0; compare receipt transit duration, not absolute epoch
